faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Cardigan Welsh Corgi?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 25-38 lb (11-17 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.question: Which health issues should I watch for in a adult Cardigan Welsh Corgi?
faqs.answer: This stage guide highlights Intervertebral disc disease (IVDD); Progressive retinal atrophy (PRA); Hip dysplasia. Use the linked symptom pages for red flags, then contact your clinic.

faqs.question: How often should I weigh my Cardigan Welsh Corgi at this stage?
faqs.answer: Every 30 days is a practical adult Cardigan Welsh Corgi default unless your veterinarian sets a tighter plan.
